peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.6% below its local comparables; 31 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (62.1): 3.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 54 of 91 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $1,480,000 ($1,202 psf, 1,205–1,754 sq ft; 13 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,209 psf (range $966–1,255); 0.6% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $9,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tampines East MRT about 850 m, Upper Changi MRT about 870 m; closer than 22 of 94 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest East Spring Primary School about 330 m; more than 19 of 94 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 510 m), more than 35 of 94 similar developments (the same as 12); nearest hawker centre Tampines Round Market And Food Centre about 1,860 m; nearest park Tampines Eco Green Park about 1,840 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Tampines Round Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Kassia, 22 new sales, about 960 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 33 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 22 new sales and 555 resales (577 purchases); new sales were 3.8% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 555 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 68 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 555 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 720 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−22.9%). Planning-area private resales −24.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
